_comment: Single source of truth for subscription pricing (ABA-320 / tech-debt pricing-table-triple-copy). Amounts in smallest currency units (cents/groszy/kopecks), PPP-adjusted per market. Consumed directly by subscriptions.service.ts and setup-stripe-products.ts, and read via json.load() by docs/marketing/landing/build_landing.py. Does NOT drive what Stripe actually charges — that's resolved separately via STRIPE_*_PRICE_ID_* env vars (see resolvePriceId() in subscriptions.service.ts).
